name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.309.0 — The host names its runner grammar: the grounding contract documents the {file} placeholder in testCommand and typecheckCommand, the optional trunk key, capabilities.failCountPattern and a fail-closed forge (github or none; absent or other means no forge adapter); /spec:init profiles forge, trunk, file placement and failCountPattern; /spec:doctor runs init-gen grammar-check and nudges on an undeclared capabilities.forge. [breaking: a host with no capabilities.forge stops observing CI until /spec:init writes it]. 7.308.0 — direction flips now leave escape rows: a commit that supersedes a spec and a review merge that deletes a done spec's created file each append one row (class spec-superseded / shipped-file-deleted) through escape-row.js; new supersession-rows.js. 7.307.0 — Gate scope and slow tier: the grounding contract gains the optional slowTestCommand key and a Test tiers section (the fast testCommand tier versus a once-per-legs-iteration blocking slow leg); init profiles runner path-acceptance and boot/build/service tests, asks where the slow tier lives and writes {testDirs} into gateCommand; doctor check 25 reports an unscoped gate and a missing slow tier.
